maya (docs): FYI opened PR #428 for the SDK snippets + migration guide — needs review + docs preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/428 :eyes:
alex (docs): looking now. small heads-up: prefer the new glossary term 'model profile' instead of 'model card' in the guide. Also there's a bolded product-term in the header that should be plain sentence case.
june (docs-reviewer): quick nits:
- fmt: add blank line before the example code block
- voice: avoid 'you can' -> use active verbs like 'use' or 'call'
- API: example still shows `InferenceClient.create()` (old) -> should be `RedwoodClient.create()`
maya (docs): good catches, i'll patch. CI/docs preview is pending: https://ci.redwood.ai/preview/428
alex (docs): pushing a commit to fix the API call + header. snippet to validate (runs locally for me):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rdc = RedwoodClient()
await rdc.connect()
resp = await rdc.generate('Hello')
print(resp.text)
```
sam (eng): ping @alex — did you validate the async example works with runtime v0.9 and the dedicated config? :thinking:
alex (docs): yes tested on v0.9 locally; i missed the `await rdc.connect()` line earlier, added it now. pushing again.
tara (pm): tiny terminology request: prefer 'throughput' instead of 'requests/sec' in the migration section to align with SLO docs.
maya (docs): updated wording + added glossary footnote for 'model profile'. fixed bullet spacing and code fence.
june (docs-reviewer): lgtm pending CI. one more suggestion: the quantization example uses `quantize(level=8)` — add a one-line note about perf vs quality tradeoffs.
maya (docs): added that note. CI re-run queued.
ci-bot: docs preview is ready — https://preview.redwood.ai/428 :white_check_mark:
sam (eng): smoke-tested the snippet on a dedicated node with the migration steps — works as expected. :thumbsup: 
alex (docs): approving in PR.
june (docs-reviewer): approved.
maya (docs): plan: merge after the 10:00am PT deploy window to avoid freeze. will watch the prod-site rollout.
tara (pm): noted — if any regression shows up, hold and revert. otherwise merge after window opens. :white_check_mark:
maya (docs): merging now, thanks all :raised_hands:
